description: Daily foreign-exchange reference rates for the major fiat currencies (USD, EUR, CNY, GBP, JPY, HKD and more) from the European Central Bank via Frankfurter: convert amounts, price in a local currency, or sanity-check a rate before a payment. Give a base currency and optional symbols and amount. Reference rates are published once per working day; they are not live trading quotes.
name: fx-rates
